phases.name: Strategy
phases.description: Define business justification, cloud motivations, financial model, and stakeholder alignment.
milestones: Business case and ROI approved
Executive sponsorship secured
Target region and compliance scope defined
phases.landfall_coverage: Financial baseline, Proof of Estimate (POE), and discovery questionnaire business motivations.

phases.name: Plan
phases.description: Discover estate, assess data quality, right-size compute/storage, assign 6R dispositions, and sequence migration waves.
milestones: Inventory discovery and DQ validation
Deterministic right-sizing and pricing BoM
6R disposition assignment and rationale
Dependency mapping and move-group clustering
Risk-ordered wave plan and schedule with critical path
phases.landfall_coverage: Full deterministic automated coverage across inventory, cost, wave, and effort engines.

phases.name: Ready
phases.description: Prepare Azure Landing Zone baseline, network connectivity, identity, governance, and security controls.
milestones: Management group hierarchy and subscription topology established
Hub-spoke network and IP routing configured
Hybrid identity and RBAC baseline verified
Security baseline (Key Vault, Defender, policies) active
phases.landfall_coverage: Deterministic Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) Azure Landing Zone design, diagram, and checklist conformance scoring.

phases.name: Adopt
phases.description: Execute workload migration, server replication, data synchronization, business testing, and cutover.
milestones: Replication appliance deployed
Pilot wave executed and verified
Business acceptance testing completed
Production cutover and rollback windows executed
phases.landfall_coverage: Execution-readiness checklist and runbook guidance. Note: Landfall produces execution-readiness deliverables; it does not execute live migration.

phases.name: Govern
phases.description: Enforce corporate policies, cost management, budget alerts, and compliance auditing.
milestones: Azure Policy baseline assigned and compliant
Cost Management budgets and threshold alerts active
Resource tagging and naming standards enforced
phases.landfall_coverage: Cost guardrails, budget alerts, policy overlay in landing zone design, and assumptions register.

phases.name: Manage
phases.description: Maintain operational baselines, disaster recovery, monitoring, and workload optimization.
milestones: Centralized Log Analytics workspace and alerts operational
Backup and DR replication policies active
Post-migration right-sizing and reservation coverage verified
phases.landfall_coverage: Run-rate extras (monitoring, backup, support) and landing-zone DR topology design.
